ideas.pitch: An AI-powered maritime traffic anomaly detection system leveraging historical AIS data from coastal Galicia to predict illegal fishing and maritime trade bottlenecks.
ideas.title: Galician Maritime Traffic Predictive Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages technical difficulty and rigorous predictive modeling similar to winning projects, appealing directly to local judges interested in regional marine economy impact.

ideas.pitch: Real-time density forecasting and pilgrim distribution optimizer for local tourism boards along the Camino de Santiago trail network.
ideas.title: Camino de Santiago Smart Crowd Flow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Taps into local pride for A Coruña and Galicia, offering immediate real-world utility for regional tourism management with a working live map demo.

ideas.pitch: A discrete-event simulation and predictive bottleneck identifier for local port logistics to optimize container truck dispatches.
ideas.title: Port of A Coruña Container Flow Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on hard engineering and a working, data-backed live visualization that demonstrates immediate commercial value for local port authorities.

ideas.pitch: Computer vision tool using bottle label metadata and spectral analysis simulation to verify Denomination of Origin authenticity for local Galician wines.
ideas.title: Galician Wine Appellation Authenticator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines accessible mobile-friendly computer vision with a culturally relevant local industry, making for a memorable and highly demonstrable live presentation.

ideas.pitch: Wind and wave energy output forecasting tool built for regional micro-grids in A Coruña to predict surplus and deficit intervals.
ideas.title: Galician Renewable Energy Grid Balancer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a high-priority regional infrastructure challenge using time-series forecasting techniques proven to win technical hackathons.
